_comment: Fallback allowlist for sync.py, used only when lingq_languages.py can't fetch LingQ's live /api/v2/languages/ catalog (missing LINGQ_API_KEY, or the call failing) -- see mirror.yml and README.md. The real allowlist is fetched fresh every scheduled run; this file is a manually-reviewed snapshot so a LingQ-side outage degrades gracefully instead of failing the job.
